terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, HDR, FPS, Steam, Playnite, GitHub, API names, paths, commands, shortcut keys, placeholders, and versions remain unchanged.
Traditional Chinese uses 控制器, 按鍵, 指派, 欄位, and 輸入; input listening uses 偵測 rather than media 擷取.
Press is immediate 按下; release-based Tap is 短按; 按兩下, 按三下, and 長按 remain distinct, and completed Hold suppresses Tap.
重播 names the feature, 重播緩衝區 its rolling recording, 短片 a saved video, 錄製 the recording process, and 播放 ordinary playback.
螢幕截圖, 擷取內容, 圖庫, 媒體庫, 遊戲內嵌介面, and 通知區域 denote distinct product concepts.
Update security uses 資訊清單, 檢查碼, 簽章, 暫存, 交易, 信任狀態, and 檔案損壞.
Portable import uses 可攜式, 暫存, 記錄檔, 字串, 根目錄, 來源, 執行個體, 資料庫, and 外部索引鍵; portable:/ stays literal.
Traditional Chinese uses one Qt numerus form while preserving explicit quantities and counters.
Controls use concise actions; explanatory text uses neutral Taiwan-oriented software terminology and full-width punctuation.
Internal staging publish operations use final-position or completion wording rather than public-release 發佈 terminology.
Taiwan UI wording uses 螢幕截圖 and 全螢幕; release notes use neutral phrasing instead of mixing 你 and 您.
calibration_rules: Review every stable ID with its English source, location, control role, and neighboring UI; character conversion alone is not linguistic evidence.
Use concise controls and natural Traditional Chinese for explanatory prose.
Preserve placeholders, protected identifiers, shortcut keys, button names, paths, commands, punctuation tokens, and versions.
Review application, installer, Playnite, native launcher, startup, and release-note surfaces separately.
Resolve capture, replay, controller input, filesystem, database, and update-security terms from product context.
Avoid touchscreen touch terminology for controller-button gestures and preserve activation timing.
